title: Scoped negative result: CK target-forest floor holds for all dyadic weights (no new kappa)
body:
## Status

**Scoped negative complex-supplier result / research note; no new κ.** Extends the historical PR626 CK target-forest floor from signed powers of two to **every nonzero dyadic rational** under the same independent binary-Horner lowering and leaf-before-parent one-parent forest contract. Only `research/ck-all-dyadic-forest-seed23/` is added.

## New evidence

- Exact **13,501,152-case** CK census: 12,432 ordered target pairs × 1,086 dyadics `n/8`, `1 <= |n| <= 543`; written valuation/magnitude tails close the infinite remainder.
- Every nonunit finite-core edge loses to a root or same-parent signed unit, with minimum excess **63 component primitives**. The existing **16,364-component-primitive floor** remains attained; no new circuit saving is claimed.
- A necessary correction to the natural proof strategy: **941 nonunit CK cases beat their root**, minimum **−116** at child114/parent184/λ=−3. Thus PR964's stronger root-only power-weight comparison cannot simply be generalized; the same-parent forest exchange is essential.
- Primary exact gcd/histogram/16-bit-lane checker and separately implemented dense/integer/20-bit-lane oracle agree on the **complete** census, histogram and cost-stream digest.
- Rechecks the predecessor's unit floor using dense Prim and all **12,544** cycle inequalities; all **716 arbitrary logical input columns in both orientations** pass for the existing witness and a mixed nonunit forest with106 overlapping parent edges. Ten mathematical controls plus source-corruption/missing-input packaging controls pass.

## Novelty and credit

Initial powers-of-two exploration was abandoned after discovering **Gareth Davidson's incorporated #964**, which already closes that CK domain. This is the explicitly open **non-power dyadic numerator** class, not a larger repeat of that search. The universal tails and forest-exchange method are credited to **woklerx's #961**, which applies to the different X4 matrix. Credit **@dd-hemant #816** for the CK forest, attaining witness and original scalar savings, plus **ToikY #909**, **Oscar Fennell #759**, **Sricharan Vagvala #749**, **Ross Richardson #917/#932**, **David Awad #807**, and the retained Chafik Boukhalfa/Jeremy Kothe/icekylinx/DreamingOfClouds/eumemic lineage. Related #1080/#1081 change helper-side assumptions; their savings are not composed here.

OS assignment seed **23**, complex-supplier track. Exact base **1b59b624d21924f8e3537cdc1ac52d3be6eda2fe**, also the final refreshed upstream. Three candidates, one overlap-driven pivot, complete domain/stopping rule, source pins, proof, certificate, controls and validation receipts are included. Selected PR1094 conditional κ remains **0.001672660197076918**.

## Reproduce

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/ck-all-dyadic-forest-seed23/verify.py && python3 -I -O -B research/ck-all-dyadic-forest-seed23/independent.py
python3 -I -O -B research/ck-all-dyadic-forest-seed23/test_package.py
```

Observed on Linux x64 / CPython3.14.4:

```text
PASS_CK_ALL_DYADIC_FOREST cases=13501152 floor=16364 margin=63 columns=716x2 controls=10 no_new_kappa
PASS_CK_PACKED_ORACLE cases=13501152 exact_lane_bits=20 full_receipt_match
PASS_CK_DYADIC_PACKAGE source_corruption=2 missing_source=1 optimized=1 outputs_preserved=1
```

Final primary+oracle command: **609.15 seconds** in the shared environment; packaging controls18.87 seconds. These are observed execution records, not controlled performance claims. Interrupted development invocations and exact successful replacements are disclosed in `VALIDATION.md`.

## Limits

This fixes the source matrix, one-parent forest schedule and historical independent binary-Horner tariff. It does not settle multiple parents, arbitrary sequential shears, helper-basis changes, shared coefficient work, stronger scalar lowerings or folded boundaries. No changed supplier, fresh native/emitter/Clifford replay, prefix/precision claim, global hosting/invoice/assembly, selected cold replay, repository-wide suite, hosted CI or full multiplication theorem is claimed. Inherited all-size/compiler, realization, hosting, precision/tape and analytic assumptions remain. `upstream/` and selected frontier are unchanged.

Prepared by **Adam Gall (@adamgall)** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance** in research, implementation, proof, tests and writing. Both implementations are AI-written; no independent human review is claimed. Apache-2.0; existing source notices and licenses remain intact.
